name: Game Flow
description: Lobby, countdown, rounds, winners — runs your game from start to end. Works with: Leaderboard, Announcer.

changelog.notes: Initial release: lobby → round → winners on game.round, a countdown every client derives from one shared deadline, a winners line read from the board key a Leaderboard shows, and a "script" mode where your own game.newRound() ends the round and the round length is only a ceiling
